Ice Magic Overview
Ice Magic
uses devastating attacks, combined with the randomness of weather and the freezing abilities of ice to create a deadly skill with medium-high power cost. Like other research based magics,
Ice Magic
abilities are learned through the sacrifice of ingredients to research spells.
In-Game Description
A specialization of Fire Magic that focuses entirely upon lowering temperature instead of raising it. It has protective and controlling abilities as well as offensive abilities.
Training Ice Magic
Ice Magic
is taught by
Landri the Cold
after completing a
quest
inside
Kur Tower
. To begin this quest, a Prodigy should look for a warning sign posted directly inside the dungeon. One must also have Level 25
Fire Magic
or Level 25
Rabbit
.
Ichin the Ice Master
can unlock Levels 51-70
Ice Magic
, and teaches the associated recipes.
Bendith the Banished
will have Levels 71-80 frozen into your brain.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Reinath
deep beneath
Povus
.

Ability overview
Ice Spear: High range attack spell, great damage.
Ice Lightning: Electricity damage, must-have to fight ice resistant mobs.
Tundra Spikes: Mid-range AoE that locks mobs in place so you can get out of melee range and attack with ranged spells. Can be modded with
stun
.
Blizzard: High-range AoE,
slows
enemies while you retreat. Can be modded to
reduce rage
.
Frostbite: Randomized
stun
. Can be modded for more enemy debuffs like raising max rage or chance to miss.
Freeze Solid: Mesmerize an enemy when you are overwhelmed, but watch out when using AoEs or it will break.
Ice Nova: Short-range AoE, can be modded to heal.
Cold Protection: Sidebar self-only buff to protect from ice damage and reduce heat loss in cold areas.
Cryogenic Freeze: 10-second self-stun, only useful if you need a short break to recover health. Can be modded to recover health, armor, power.

Research Ingredients
Ice Magic
can be viewed as expensive due to the ingredients required for spell research recipes. Each recipe unlocks a selection of abilities in a random order.
If you complete
Ice Magic Research Level 25
, you will learn one of six abilities (Blizzard 2, Chill 2, Cryogenic Freeze, Ice Armor 3, Ice Lightning 3, Tundra Spikes 2). Complete
Ice Magic Research Level 25
six times to learn all associated abilities.

Ice Conjuration- A sub-skill of Ice Magic dedicated to the creation of delicate ice items. These items tend to melt in hot environments.
Fire Magic- Well-studied fire mages may be drawn towards the chilly arts ofIce Magic.
Ice Spear: High range attack spell, great damage.
Ice Lightning: Electricity damage, must-have to fight ice resistant mobs.
Tundra Spikes: Mid-range AoE that locks mobs in place so you can get out of melee range and attack with ranged spells. Can be modded withstun.

Ice Nova: Short-range AoE, can be modded to heal.
Cold Protection: Sidebar self-only buff to protect from ice damage and reduce heat loss in cold areas.
